source: Blum LEGRABOX Ordering and planning information (CA edition, PDF created 2023-06-12), d2.blum.com/services/BEC003/me77914225_ep_dok_bau_$sen-ca_$aof_$v1.pdf. Verified there: side heights N 66.5 / M 90.5 / C 177 / F 241 and chipboard back heights 39 / 63 / 148 / 212 (pp. 6, 11, 15, 25, 55); cutting for 16 mm chipboard: drawer base LW − 35 × NL − 10, chipboard back LW − 38 (pp. 11, 15); LT min = NL + 3; profile 750 lengths 270, 350–600, side set N only in NL 450/500, F only in NL 450–600 (pp. 8, 12, 52–55); profile screw axis min 38 above the cabinet bottom (+1 if fitted before assembly); system screw positions from the 37 mm hole: NL 270: 0, 32, 160; NL 350: 0, 32, 224; NL 400–500: 0, 32, 224, 256; NL 550–600: 0, 32, 224, 256, 320 (p. 69; the extra front screw 18 mm from the front edge and the chipboard-only screw 18 mm ahead of the 224 hole are screwed without a system hole and are not drilled here); EXPANDO front holes Ø10, 14 from the cabinet side's inner face, lowest hole 45.5 (N) / 51 (M, C, F) above the cabinet bottom at the lowest profile position, i.e. 7.5 / 13 above the profile screw axis, further holes 16 (N), 32 (M), 32 + 96 (C), 32 + 96 + 32 + 32 (F) above (pp. 10, 14, 24, 54). PLACEHOLDERS, not verified: axisToBox 24.5 (drawer side underside below the screw axis, derived from the space requirements min 42 / 68 / 155 / 219 above the axis minus the side heights; the drawer base is placed at the side underside) and the EXPANDO hole depth 11 (not stated in the source; min front thickness 12). Heights C and F are high fronted pull-outs: their design element / gallery parts are not in this item's bill of materials.
